name: recall
description:
Show a stored tool result again, in full, by its id (`#a3f2`): the lines a shortened output left out, or a result from before the conversation was summarised. Every result of this session is kept, so nothing is lost.

- Returns up to 2000 lines from `offset` (1-indexed); call again with a larger offset for more.
- An unchanged file is not worth recalling when its earlier result is still above: that result is the content.
